name: neural-weights-cjk
phase: Second functional graph: the v8-cjk-kr 24k run (Japanese + Korean + Chinese under the 49-label head), staged at cjk/v0.0.2/ on the Hugging Face bucket (#2184). Replaces the v8-cjk-kana graph (cjk/v0.0.1/).

format.model: ONNX fp32 (opset 17), inputs char_ids int64 (batch, sequence, 7) + attention_mask int64 (batch, sequence), output logits (batch, sequence, 49). No SentencePiece tokenizer: the encoder is one unit per Unicode code point with a ±3 character window over the sealed vocabulary in char-vocab.json (3,165 entries, <pad> 0, <unk> 1, code-point order).

files_md5.$comment: The candidate artifacts' md5s — what a materialized package is verified against.

training.run: v8-cjk-kr seed 42, 24,000 steps, batch 256, bf16, cosine, from scratch (corpus-python/src/mailwoman_train/configs/v8-cjk-kr.yaml)
training.corpus: v8-cjk-kr-2026-09-06 overlay: the v8-jp-kana-2026-09-06 JP corpus (2,000,000 train rows, Overture-JP, five registers) plus the v8-kr-2026-09-06 Korean road-name-address corpus (2,000,000 train rows from juso.go.kr, five registers, 27 held-out 시군구) plus 126 CN organizational-unit rows; source mixture overture-jp 0.60 / juso-kr 0.38 / coarse-placer-cn-units 0.02; vocabulary re-sealed over the union

jp_board_20000.$comment: Held-out municipalities on the v8-jp-kana-2026-09-06 board, coordinate-acceptability at 15 km via the municipality centroid table (corpus-python/scripts/score_jp_probe_board.py --label-set stage3-cjk --all-municipalities), PyTorch read, the v8-cjk-kana base re-scored beside it on the same scorer. The kana_municipality register (1,127 rows) is unresolved by the kanji-keyed centroid table on both arms (1,125 gold-exact), which is why the blended number sits under the native register's.
jp_board_20000.note: かすみがうら市 (823 held-out rows) fails 0 on both arms; 中新川郡上市町 fails 124 of 130 (the base 120) — the model closes the municipality at the inner 市, which the runtime's JP municipality register repair closes for the six such towns (#2178).

kr_board_20000.$comment: 27 held-out 시군구, five registers (official, no_dong, postcode_first, short_region, unspaced); per-tag span exact-match, PyTorch read (score_jp_probe_board.py --resolve-tags region,subregion --centroids kr-sigungu-centroids.json). Pre-registered bars: street and house_number ≥ 0.99, subregion ≥ 0.97, dependent_locality ≥ 0.95, region and postcode ≥ 0.99.
kr_board_20000.note: subregion misses the 0.97 bar by 0.0035: 669 of the 671 misses are one held-out city, 해운대구 (669 of its 681 rows), emitted as 해 or 해운대 — zero training rows by design and 해남군 (9,614 rows) the only frequent 해-initial 시군구 in training. The other 26 held-out cities read 19,317 of 19,319. Coordinate acceptability carries the short_region register (2,992 rows, 서울 for 서울특별시) unresolved by the centroid key on every row, 2,722 of them gold-exact.

cn_board_14.$comment: locality_unit span exact-match, PyTorch per-unit argmax.

model_lineage: 0.0.1: v8-cjk-full step-024000 (fp32 ONNX md5 e14ef4c426dabb22e9433ab04b584d48). Decision record: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-cjk-serving-path.md; receipts on #1176, #2034, #2164.
notes: One CJK package a consumer installs as a unit (#1177 Phase B): Japanese and Chinese ride one 49-label head; ja-jp and zh-cn data-only overlays follow.
Channel-free by contract (D5): no postcode-anchor, gazetteer, country or evidence channels; the graph declares only char_ids and attention_mask.

Korean rides the same head with no new tag: 시/도 → region, 시군구 → subregion (WOF counties), 읍면동 → dependent_locality, 도로명 → street, 건물번호 → house_number, 우편번호 → postcode (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-06-kr-under-the-cjk-package.md).
